114|def _usage(entry: dict, ctx: Any = None) -> None:
115|    if ctx is not None and not _bool_cfg(ctx, "usage_enabled", True):
116|        return
117|    try:
118|        path = _usage_path()
119|        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
120|        line = json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n"
121|        if len(line.encode("utf-8")) > _MAX_USAGE_BYTES:
122|            line = json.dumps({"event": "usage_entry_oversize"}) + "\n"
123|        with _AUDIT_LOCK:
124|            backup = path.with_name(path.name + ".1")
125|            if backup.exists() and backup.stat().st_size > _MAX_USAGE_BYTES:
126|                backup.unlink(missing_ok=True)
127|            if path.exists() and path.stat().st_size > _MAX_USAGE_BYTES:
128|                path.write_text(json.dumps({"event": "usage_history_truncated"}) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
129|            if path.exists() and path.stat().st_size + len(line.encode("utf-8")) > _MAX_USAGE_BYTES:
130|                os.replace(path, backup)
131|            with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
132|                f.write(line)
133|    except Exception:
134|        pass

137|def _after_chars(stats: dict, before: int) -> int:
138|    """Chars after compression, with passthrough gates counted as unchanged.
139|
140|    Passthrough gates never set after_chars, so a row read after=0 and every
141|    aggregate of 1-after/before reported them as 100% saved (inflated the
142|    headline ~3.5x: real is ~9%, not ~44%).
143|    """
144|    after = int(stats.get("after_chars") or 0)
145|    return after if after else max(before - int(stats.get("saved_chars") or 0), 0)

315|def _store_original(
316|    original: str, compressed: str, digest: str, ctx: Any
317|) -> tuple[str, str] | None:

333|def _compile_grep(source: str) -> re.Pattern[str]:
334|    if len(source) > _MAX_GREP_PATTERN_CHARS:
335|        raise ValueError(f"pattern exceeds {_MAX_GREP_PATTERN_CHARS} characters")
336|
337|    repeats = 0
338|    in_class = False
339|    escaped = False
340|    last_was_repeat = False
341|    for char in source:
342|        if escaped:
343|            if char.isdigit():
344|                raise ValueError("backreferences are not supported in grep patterns")
345|            escaped = False
346|            last_was_repeat = False
347|            continue
348|        if char == "\\":
349|            escaped = True
350|            last_was_repeat = False
351|            continue
352|        if in_class:
353|            if char == "]":
354|                in_class = False
355|            continue
356|        if char == "[":
357|            in_class = True
358|            last_was_repeat = False
359|            continue
360|        if char in "(){}":
361|            raise ValueError("groups and counted repetition are not supported in grep patterns")
362|        if char in "*+?":
363|            if char == "?" and last_was_repeat:
364|                last_was_repeat = False
365|                continue
366|            repeats += 1
367|            if repeats > 1:
368|                raise ValueError("only one repetition operator is supported in grep patterns")
369|            last_was_repeat = True
370|        else:
371|            last_was_repeat = False
372|    return re.compile(source, re.IGNORECASE)

375|def _finalize(
376|    raw: str,
377|    compressed: str,
378|    stats: dict,
379|    ctx: Any,
380|    audit_base: dict,
381|) -> str | None:
382|    if stats.get("gate") != "ok":
383|        return None
384|    if stats.get("lossless_tier0"):
385|        # v4.2 Tier 0: nothing was removed, so there is nothing to retrieve --
386|        # skip the SQLite CCR write entirely and ship the cleaned text.
387|        _audit({
388|            **audit_base,
389|            "before_chars": stats.get("before_chars"),
390|            "after_chars": stats.get("after_chars"),
391|            "saved_chars": stats.get("saved_chars"),
392|            "gate": "ok",
393|            "hash": "tier0_lossless",
394|            "ms": round(float(stats.get("ms", 0.0)), 2),
395|        }, ctx=ctx)
396|        return compressed
397|    stored = _store_original(raw, compressed, str(stats.get("digest", "")), ctx)
398|    if stored is None:
399|        return None
400|    new_text, digest = stored
401|    _audit({
402|        **audit_base,
403|        "before_chars": stats.get("before_chars"),
404|        "after_chars": stats.get("after_chars"),
405|        "saved_chars": stats.get("saved_chars"),
406|        "gate": "ok",
407|        "hash": digest,
408|        "ms": round(float(stats.get("ms", 0.0)), 2),
409|    }, ctx=ctx)
410|    return new_text

445|def _on_tool_result(
446|    tool_name: Any = None,
447|    args: Any = None,
448|    result: Any = None,
449|    session_id: Any = None,
450|    task_id: Any = None,
451|    turn_id: Any = None,
452|    **kw: Any,
453|) -> str | None:
454|    ctx = _on_tool_result._ctx  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
455|    if not _bool_cfg(ctx, "enabled", True):
456|        return None
457|    if not _bool_cfg(ctx, "phase2_enabled", True):
458|        return None
459|    if not isinstance(result, str):
460|        return None
461|    if _excluded_tool(tool_name, ctx):
462|        return None
463|    verbatim_name = str(tool_name or "").strip()
464|    if verbatim_name in VERBATIM_TOOLS and verbatim_name not in _READ_FILE_LIKE:
465|        return None
466|    sid = str(session_id or task_id or "default")
467|    turn = str(turn_id or "")
468|    # The tool args (path/offset/limit) decide whether a read is a full read or
469|    # a targeted slice -- if the caller passed them elsewhere, use that.
470|    effective_args = args if args is not None else (
471|        kw.get("tool_args") or kw.get("arguments") or kw.get("input"))
472|    new_result, stats = compress_tool_result(
473|        str(tool_name or ""),
474|        result,
475|        args=effective_args,
476|        session_id=sid,
477|        min_chars=_int_cfg(ctx, "min_chars", 2048, 0, 10_000_000),
478|        toon_enabled=_bool_cfg(ctx, "toon_enabled", True),
479|        deadline=Deadline(_float_cfg(ctx, "guard_ms", 200.0, 1.0, 1000.0)),
480|    )
481|    _usage_tool(tool_name, result, stats, ctx)
482|    out = _finalize(result, new_result, stats, ctx, {
483|        "tool": str(tool_name or "tool"),
484|        "kind": "tool_result",
485|    })
486|    if out is not None or stats.get("gate") == "passthrough_reference":
487|        # note_turn even for a verbatim read: expire_old_turns ages the file
488|        # cache by turn, and a read that is never noted never expires.
489|        note_turn(result, str(stats.get("digest", "")), session_id=sid, turn_id=turn)
490|    return out

515|def _parse_ref(raw: Any) -> str:
516|    ref = str(raw or "").strip().strip("<>").strip()
517|    ref = ref.removeprefix("tt:").split(",")[0].strip()
518|    ref = ref.removeprefix("retrieve:").strip()
519|    if ref.startswith("#"):
520|        return "#" + re.sub(r"[^0-9A-Za-z]", "", ref[1:])[:16]
521|    if re.match(r"^c[0-9A-Za-z]+$", ref) and len(ref) <= 8:
522|        return "#" + ref
523|    hex_ref = "".join(c for c in ref if c in "0123456789abcdef")[:16]
524|    if hex_ref:
525|        return hex_ref
526|    return re.sub(r"[^0-9A-Za-z]", "", ref)[:16]

538|def _render_context_intervals(
539|    lines: list[str], match_indices: list[int], ctx_lines: int
540|) -> tuple[str, int]:
541|    total_lines = len(lines)
542|    intervals: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
543|    for idx in match_indices:
544|        s = max(0, idx - ctx_lines)
545|        e = min(total_lines, idx + ctx_lines + 1)
546|        if not intervals:
547|            intervals.append((s, e))
548|        else:
549|            last_s, last_e = intervals[-1]
550|            if s <= last_e:
551|                intervals[-1] = (last_s, max(last_e, e))
552|            else:
553|                intervals.append((s, e))
554|    chunks: list[str] = []
555|    returned_lines = 0
556|    for s, e in intervals:
557|        chunk_lines = [f"{i + 1}|{lines[i]}" for i in range(s, e)]
558|        returned_lines += len(chunk_lines)
559|        chunks.append("\n".join(chunk_lines))
560|    return "\n[...]\n".join(chunks), returned_lines

563|def _handle_retrieve(args: dict, **kw: Any) -> str:
564|    ref = _parse_ref((args or {}).get("hash"))
565|    if not ref:
566|        return _err("hash is required (a '#ref' from a [tt:...] marker, or a legacy hex hash)")
567|    ctx = getattr(_handle_retrieve, "_ctx", None)
568|    ttl_hours = _int_cfg(ctx, "ccr_ttl_hours", 24, 1, 24 * 30) if ctx is not None else 24
569|    content = ccr_get(ref, ttl_hours=ttl_hours)
570|    if content is None:
571|        _usage_retrieve(args, hit=False, ctx=ctx)
572|        return _err("Not found or expired (TTL passed). Re-run the original command instead.")
573|
574|    grep = str((args or {}).get("grep") or "").strip()
575|    if grep:
576|        try:
577|            if len(content) > _MAX_GREP_INPUT_CHARS:
578|                return _err(
579|                    f"Content exceeds the {_MAX_GREP_INPUT_CHARS}-character grep limit; retrieve a smaller slice."
580|                )
581|            pattern = _compile_grep(grep)
582|            lines = content.splitlines()
583|            total_lines = len(lines)
584|            matched: list[str] = []
585|            output_chars = 0
586|            matches_count = 0
587|            truncated = False
588|            for i, line in enumerate(lines):
589|                if not pattern.search(line):
590|                    continue
591|                matches_count += 1
592|                rendered = f"{i + 1}|{line}"
593|                extra = len(rendered) + (1 if matched else 0)
594|                if len(matched) >= _MAX_GREP_MATCHES or output_chars + extra > _MAX_GREP_OUTPUT_CHARS:
595|                    truncated = True
596|                    continue
597|                matched.append(rendered)
598|                output_chars += extra
599|            _usage_retrieve(args, hit=True, ctx=ctx, mode="grep",
600|                            matches=matches_count, truncated=truncated)
601|            return _ok({
602|                "matches": "\n".join(matched) if matched else "(no matches found)",
603|                "matches_count": matches_count,
604|                "total_lines": total_lines,
605|                "truncated": truncated,
606|            })
607|        except Exception as e:
608|            return _err(f"Invalid grep pattern: {e}")
609|
610|    lines = content.splitlines()
611|    total_lines = len(lines)
612|
613|    section = str((args or {}).get("section") or "").strip().lower()
614|    if section:
615|        ctx_lines = max(0, min(20, _safe_int((args or {}).get("context_lines"), 3)))
616|        if section == "errors":
617|            match_indices = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if is_important(line)]
618|            if not match_indices:
619|                _usage_retrieve(args, hit=True, ctx=ctx, mode="section_errors", matches=0)
620|                return _ok({
621|                    "section": "errors",
622|                    "error_matches": 0,
623|                    "total_lines": total_lines,
624|                    "lines": "(no error lines detected)",
625|                })
626|            formatted, returned_lines = _render_context_intervals(lines, match_indices, ctx_lines)
627|            _usage_retrieve(args, hit=True, ctx=ctx, mode="section_errors",
628|                            matches=len(match_indices), returned=returned_lines, total=total_lines)
629|            return _ok({
630|                "section": "errors",
631|                "error_matches": len(match_indices),
632|                "returned_lines": returned_lines,
633|                "total_lines": total_lines,
634|                "lines": formatted,
635|            })
636|        if section == "diff":
637|            diff_indices = []
638|            diff_prefixes = ("diff --git ", "--- ", "+++ ", "index ", "similarity index ", "new file mode ", "deleted file mode ")
639|            for i, line in enumerate(lines):
640|                if line.startswith(diff_prefixes) or line.startswith("@@ "):
641|                    diff_indices.append(i)
642|                elif (line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++")) or (line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---")):
643|                    diff_indices.append(i)
644|            if not diff_indices:
645|                _usage_retrieve(args, hit=True, ctx=ctx, mode="section_diff", matches=0)
646|                return _ok({
647|                    "section": "diff",
648|                    "diff_matches": 0,
649|                    "total_lines": total_lines,
650|                    "lines": "(no diff hunks or changes detected)",
651|                })
652|            formatted, returned_lines = _render_context_intervals(lines, diff_indices, ctx_lines)
653|            _usage_retrieve(args, hit=True, ctx=ctx, mode="section_diff",
654|                            matches=len(diff_indices), returned=returned_lines, total=total_lines)
655|            return _ok({
656|                "section": "diff",
657|                "diff_matches": len(diff_indices),
658|                "returned_lines": returned_lines,
659|                "total_lines": total_lines,
660|                "lines": formatted,
661|            })
662|        if section == "summary":
663|            error_indices = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if is_important(line)]
664|            head_count = min(15, total_lines)
665|            head_lines = [f"{i + 1}|{lines[i]}" for i in range(head_count)]
666|            tail_start = max(head_count, total_lines - 25)
667|            tail_lines = [f"{i + 1}|{lines[i]}" for i in range(tail_start, total_lines)]
668|            top_errors = [f"{i + 1}|{lines[i]}" for i in error_indices[:20]]
669|            _usage_retrieve(args, hit=True, ctx=ctx, mode="section_summary",
670|                            errors=len(error_indices), total=total_lines)
671|            return _ok({
672|                "section": "summary",
673|                "total_lines": total_lines,
674|                "total_chars": len(content),
675|                "error_lines_count": len(error_indices),
676|                "head_lines": "\n".join(head_lines),
677|                "tail_lines": "\n".join(tail_lines),
678|                "top_errors": "\n".join(top_errors) if top_errors else "(none)",
679|            })
680|        if section == "tail":
681|            limit = _safe_int((args or {}).get("limit"), 50)
682|            cnt = max(1, min(1000, limit))
683|            tail_start = max(0, total_lines - cnt)
684|            tail_slice = [f"{tail_start + i + 1}|{line}" for i, line in enumerate(lines[tail_start:])]
685|            _usage_retrieve(args, hit=True, ctx=ctx, mode="section_tail",
686|                            returned=len(tail_slice), total=total_lines)
687|            return _ok({
688|                "section": "tail",
689|                "returned_lines": len(tail_slice),
690|                "total_lines": total_lines,
691|                "lines": "\n".join(tail_slice),
692|            })
693|        return _err(f"Invalid section '{section}'. Allowed: 'errors', 'diff', 'summary', 'tail'")
694|
695|    offset = (args or {}).get("offset")
696|    limit = (args or {}).get("limit")
697|    if offset is not None or limit is not None:
698|        start = max(0, _safe_int(offset, 1) - 1)
699|        cnt = _safe_int(limit, 1000)
700|        end = min(total_lines, start + max(1, cnt))
701|        sliced = [f"{i + 1}|{lines[i]}" for i in range(start, end)]
702|        _usage_retrieve(args, hit=True, ctx=ctx, mode="slice",
703|                        offset=start + 1, returned=len(sliced), total=total_lines)
704|        return _ok({
705|            "lines": "\n".join(sliced),
706|            "offset": start + 1,
707|            "total_lines": total_lines,
708|            "returned_lines": len(sliced),
709|        })
710|
711|    _usage_retrieve(args, hit=True, ctx=ctx, mode="full", chars=len(content))
712|    return _ok({"original_content": content, "original_chars": len(content), "total_lines": total_lines})

731|def _usage_summary() -> str:
732|    try:
733|        path = _usage_path()
734|        backup = path.with_name(path.name + ".1")
735|        rows = []
736|        with _AUDIT_LOCK:
737|            for f in (backup, path):
738|                if f.exists():
739|                    for ln in f.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
740|                        s = ln.strip()
741|                        if s.startswith("{"):
742|                            try:
743|                                rows.append(json.loads(s))
744|                            except Exception:
745|                                pass
746|        if not rows:
747|            return f"trimtok v{VERSION}: no usage logged yet."
748|        n_ok = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("gate") == "ok")
749|        saved = sum(int(r.get("saved") or 0) for r in rows if r.get("hook") in ("terminal", "tool"))
750|        gates: dict = {}
751|        shapes: dict = {}
752|        cmds: dict = {}
753|        for r in rows:
754|            if r.get("hook") in ("terminal", "tool"):
755|                g = str(r.get("gate") or "?")
756|                gates[g] = gates.get(g, 0) + 1
757|                sh = str(r.get("shape") or "?")
758|                shapes[sh] = shapes.get(sh, 0) + 1
759|                c = str(r.get("cmd") or r.get("tool") or "?")[:40]
760|                cmds[c] = [cmds.get(c, [0, 0])[0] + 1, cmds.get(c, [0, 0])[1] + int(r.get("saved") or 0)]
761|        retr = [r for r in rows if r.get("hook") == "retrieve"]
762|        hits = sum(1 for r in retr if r.get("hit"))
763|        top_g = sorted(gates.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:5]
764|        top_s = sorted(shapes.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:5]
765|        top_c = sorted(cmds.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1][1])[:5]
766|        out = [f"trimtok v{VERSION} usage: {len(rows)} events, {n_ok} folds, ~{saved:,} chars saved."]
767|        out.append("gates: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in top_g))
768|        out.append("shapes: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in top_s))
769|        out.append("top-saved: " + "; ".join(f"{k} (~{v[1]:,}c)" for k, v in top_c))
770|        out.append(f"retrieve: {hits}/{len(retr)} hits" if retr else "retrieve: none yet")
771|        return "\n".join(out)
772|    except Exception:
773|        return f"trimtok v{VERSION}: usage unavailable."

776|def _handle_ts_command(raw_args: str) -> str:
777|    arg = (raw_args or "").strip().lower()
778|    if arg in ("", "status"):
779|        try:
780|            path = _audit_path()
781|            backup = path.with_name(path.name + ".1")
782|            lines = []
783|            with _AUDIT_LOCK:
784|                for audit_file in (backup, path):
785|                    if audit_file.exists():
786|                        lines.extend(audit_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())
787|            saved = sum((json.loads(ln).get("saved_chars") or 0) for ln in lines if ln.strip().startswith("{"))
788|            ctx = getattr(_handle_ts_command, "_ctx", None)
789|            ttl_hours = _int_cfg(ctx, "ccr_ttl_hours", 24, 1, 24 * 30) if ctx is not None else 24
790|            c_stat = ccr_stats()
791|            return (
792|                f"trimtok v{VERSION}: {len(lines)} transforms logged (recent window), ~{saved:,} chars saved.\n"
793|                f"CCR Cache: {c_stat.get('entries', 0)} entries (~{c_stat.get('bytes', 0) // 1024} KB)."
794|            )
795|        except Exception:
796|            return f"trimtok v{VERSION}: status unavailable."
797|    if arg == "stats":
798|        return _handle_ts_command("status")
799|    if arg == "usage":
800|        return _usage_summary()
801|    if arg == "purge":
802|        purged = ccr_purge()
803|        return f"trimtok v{VERSION}: purged {purged} cached original files."
804|    if arg.startswith("retrieve"):
805|        h = arg.partition(" ")[2].strip()
806|        parts = h.split()
807|        if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[1] in ("errors", "diff", "summary", "tail"):
808|            return _handle_retrieve({"hash": parts[0], "section": parts[1]})
809|        return _handle_retrieve({"hash": parts[0] if parts else ""})
810|    return "Usage: /trimtok [status|stats|usage|purge|retrieve <hash> [section]]"

818|def compress_agent_payload(
819|    payload: dict | str, mode: str = "tool", **kw: Any
820|) -> tuple[dict | str, dict]:
821|    try:
822|        if isinstance(payload, str):
823|            if mode == "terminal":
824|                return compress_terminal(kw.get("command", ""), payload)
825|            return compress_tool_result(
826|                kw.get("tool_name", "agent"), payload,
827|                session_id=str(kw.get("session_id", "")),
828|            )
829|        if isinstance(payload, dict):
830|            for key in ("content", "output", "stdout", "result"):
831|                if isinstance(payload.get(key), str):
832|                    if mode == "terminal":
833|                        new_text, stats = compress_terminal(kw.get("command", ""), payload[key])
834|                    else:
835|                        new_text, stats = compress_tool_result(
836|                            str(payload.get("tool_name") or kw.get("tool_name", "agent")),
837|                            payload[key],
838|                            session_id=str(payload.get("session_id") or kw.get("session_id", "")),
839|                        )
840|                    return {**payload, key: new_text}, stats
841|        return payload, {"gate": "passthrough_non_str"}
842|    except Exception:
843|        return payload, {"gate": "passthrough_exception"}
